title: Ai bot automation for prop firms
author: Dangerous_Glass_215
selftext: The bot I’ve been using has been pretty good to me and the dev only takes a 15% payout split for access to it after a set up fee. It’s been printing pretty consistently recently. The website is fundedrun.com and they let you aim the bot on live data before taking it live to an eval so you get to see if it works or not for you
